gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.title: MMD Skin - Settings
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.opengl_lighting: Enable OpenGL lighting effects for better visuals
Maximum cached model count, auto-cleanup when exceeded
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.gpu_skinning.to: Use GPU for skinning calculation, greatly improves performance for high-poly models (requires OpenGL 4.3+, restart required)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.gpu_morph.toolt: Use GPU for vertex morph calculation (expressions, etc.), improves performance for models with many morphs (requires OpenGL 4.3+, restart required)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.max_bones.toolt: Maximum bone count for GPU skinning (512-4096), increase for complex models (restart required)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.toon_enabled.to: Enable cartoon rendering effect (cel shading, outlines, rim lighting)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.toon_levels.too: Number of lighting levels (2-5), higher values create smoother transitions
Rim light sharpness (1-10), higher values create sharper edges
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.toon_shadow.too: Shadow color (purple tint is anime style)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.toon_outline.to: Add outline stroke effect to the model
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_enabled: When disabled, hair, skirts, etc. will no longer be affected by physics
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_gravity: Gravity acceleration (MMD standard 98, higher = heavier hair, faster falling)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_fps.too: Physics simulation framerate (30-120), higher = more accurate but more CPU intensive
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_substep: Maximum substeps per frame, prevents physics explosion during lag
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_inertia: How much hair is dragged when character moves (0=none, 100=normal)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_max_lin: Linear velocity limit, prevents physics explosion from lag or extreme forces
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_max_ang: Angular velocity limit, prevents physics explosion
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_joints_: Disable to let hair fall apart (for debugging)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_kinemat: Filter collisions between hair and body parts (e.g. chest) to prevent jitter from clipping
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.first_person_mo: Show MMD model in first-person view (auto-hides head, camera height matches model head)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.first_person_ca: Adjust camera forward/backward position in first person. Higher values move camera forward, lower values move it backward. Drag to the right to fix seeing inside the model.
Adjust camera vertical position in first person. Higher values move camera up, lower values move it down.

gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.texture_cache_b: VRAM soft budget for texture cache (MB). Only constrains unreferenced pending-release textures, does not affect active textures. Lower saves VRAM, higher speeds up model switching
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.debug_hud.toolt: Show model memory/VRAM usage info on the top-left corner of the screen
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.vr_enabled.tool: When enabled, VR player head and hand tracking will drive MMD model bones (requires Vivecraft)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.vr_arm_ik_stren: Strength of VR hand tracking driving arm bones (0%=disabled, 100%=full)
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.mob_replacement: Choose which MMD model should replace each vanilla mob locally. Each row shows the current mapping, with Choose opening the model picker and Reset returning to Vanilla Render.
message.mmdskin.quick_model.unbound: §eQuick Model %s is not bound. Bind it in model settings.

gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.performance_run: Changes here apply immediately to runtime prioritization and LOD decisions.

gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.max_visible_mod: Maximum number of player or mob MMD models updated for visibility each frame.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.animation_lod_m: Entities beyond this distance start using the medium animation update interval.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.animation_lod_f: Entities beyond this distance start using the far animation update interval.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.animation_lod_m: Frame interval used for animation updates in the medium distance band.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.animation_lod_f: Frame interval used for animation updates in the far distance band.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.max_physics_mod: Maximum number of non-local entities allowed to run physics each frame.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.physics_lod_dis: Maximum distance where non-local entities can keep physics enabled.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.mob_model_repla: One entry per line using 'namespace:entity = model_name'. Blank or invalid entries are ignored on save.
Format: minecraft:zombie = my_model. This only overrides non-player living entities.
Entity id must be a valid namespaced id.

gui.mmdskin.vr_settings.view_hint: Move model eyes, not the headset. Y+ is up; X/Z are body-local.
gui.mmdskin.vr_settings.item_hint: Both hands: item-local offsets / angles in degrees. Live preview.
gui.mmdskin.vr_radial.hold_hint: Hold the radial key again, aim, then release to select
message.mmdskin.vr_mirror.grab: Mirror shown: aim at it, hold either controller grip to move, then release to place.
gui.mmdskin.vr_settings.calibration_hint: Reach mapping preserves avatar proportions. T-pose guidance appears ahead of your headset.
message.mmdskin.vr_calibration.needs_vr: Enter Vivecraft VR mode before calibrating.
message.mmdskin.vr_calibration.model_mis: This model has no usable eye or arm calibration bones. Use the manual controls.

message.mmdskin.vr_calibration.cancelled: Calibration cancelled. Your previous edits are unchanged.
message.mmdskin.vr_calibration.ready: Pose is stable. Press your bound attack trigger to confirm calibration. Menu cancels.

message.mmdskin.vr_calibration.pose: Look forward. Extend both arms sideways at shoulder height and hold still. Menu cancels.
message.mmdskin.vr_mirror.controls: Mirror enabled: hold your hotbar-cycle binding to grab; use the trigger on off / low / high.
message.mmdskin.vr_mirror.scene_failed: Scene mirror rendering failed; low mode restored. See the log for details.
gui.mmdskin.vr_settings.arm_length_hint: Estimated shoulder-to-controller reach used to map motion. Bone lengths stay unchanged; shown as a ratio when model dimensions are unavailable.
message.mmdskin.vr_calibration.hold_stil: Hold the pose steady a little longer, release the trigger, and press again.
gui.mmdskin.vr_calibration.title: T-Pose Calibration
gui.mmdskin.vr_calibration.instruction: Stand upright, face forward, extend your arms sideways at shoulder height
gui.mmdskin.vr_calibration.confirm: Hold this pose and press the front trigger bound to attack
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.title: Hand Tracking Settings
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.tracking_hint: Controls fingers only; head and arm tracking stay active. Settings are saved per model.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.thumb_hint: Adjust curl direction first, then opposition and base offset, then gains. Model files stay unchanged.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.both_hint: Shows the left-hand value. Changing a setting applies that value to both hands.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.curl_axis_hint: Rotates the thumb's bending plane so it can curl toward the palm. Adjust each hand separately.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.opposition_hint: Positive values move the thumb toward the index finger and palm; negative values spread it outward.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.base_offset_hint: Positive values add inward bend at the thumb base. Start with small adjustments.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.base_gain_hint: Scales motion at the thumb base. 1.00× keeps the original amount.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.middle_gain_hint: Scales motion at the middle thumb joint. 1.00× keeps the original amount.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.tip_gain_hint: Scales motion at the thumb tip joint. 1.00× keeps the original amount.
gui.mmdskin.vr_hands.status_waiting: No finger data: original model animation
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.title: VR Aim Pointers
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.basic_hint: Global preferences for all avatars. These visual guides do not change interaction targets or bindings.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.colors_hint: Enter six HEX digits. Red text means the entry is incomplete. Colors and opacity preview immediately.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.size_hint: Dot radius: % of each eye's view height. Beam diameter: mm. Dot size stays constant.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.animation_hint: Press and release use the same transition time. Disabled color/size animations switch instantly; 0 ms has no transition.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.save_error: Could not save. Check that the config file is writable. The preview remains; retry or cancel.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.binding_hint: Trigger follows Vivecraft GUI click/attack/use bindings. Grab follows its hotbar-switch binding, not a fixed physical side button.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.hex_hint: Enter #RRGGBB or RRGGBB, for example #66CCFF. All six digits are required.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.visibility_hint: While UI is open shows pointers whenever a screen or mirror is open. Pointing at UI requires a hit on an interactive UI or mirror.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.hide_crosshair_hi: VR only. Hide when pointing at a screen, keyboard, radial menu or mirror; restore immediately when pointing away. Independent of pointer visibility.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.vr_keyboard.too: Replace Vivecraft's keyboard while keeping its shortcut. Includes letters, numbers, symbols and IME candidates.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.vr_keyboard_mod: Auto uses tracked fingertips or hand contact near the keyboard, and a ray with the trigger farther away. A single mode can also be selected.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.vr_keyboard_ime: Compose text with the Windows input method and select candidates in VR. Toggle with the IME/EN key. Other systems use Latin letters, numbers and symbols.
gui.mmdskin.keyboard.input_hint: Select a text field to start typing
gui.mmdskin.keyboard.ime_hint: Select a candidate or press Space; IME / EN switches input
gui.mmdskin.keyboard.latin_hint: Shift for uppercase; double-tap Shift for Caps Lock
gui.mmdskin.keyboard.focus_required: Focus the game window to use the Windows input method
gui.mmdskin.keyboard.input_unavailable: IME did not respond. Reopen the keyboard or disable system IME in settings
gui.mmdskin.keyboard.modifier_held: Release Ctrl, Alt or Windows keys on the physical keyboard first
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.left_trigger_hint: The last trigger used owns UI hover. When both are held, the first press wins; release and press the other trigger to take over.
gui.mmdskin.vr_pointer.interaction_hint: Trigger clicks switch hover. The first held trigger keeps control.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.vr_model_above_: Draw your VR model and held items in front of screens, keyboards and radial menus. Keeps the current pose and stereo perspective. Disable for normal occlusion.
gui.mmdskin.mod_settings.vr_keyboard_dra: Off: follow the controller immediately. On: smooth position and rotation separately. Dragging allows yaw and pitch only; releasing Grip stops at the displayed pose.
Larger values soften following and add delay. Milliseconds to reach about 95% of a stationary target; 0 follows immediately. Only applies when smooth keyboard dragging is enabled.
